name: tynly
description: Transform messy, mixed-language text into natural writing instantly.

scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js prettier.config.mjs src scripts assets
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js prettier.config.mjs src scripts assets
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
